Language-level create/delete/eval operations supply the requested API-exposure precedent at the management layer.

judgments.candidate_claim: Connection's send_bytes, recv_bytes, poll, close, and EOF behavior provide a reusable message-interface precedent for communication without exposing mutable interpreter-owned objects.

send_bytes/recv_bytes/poll/close/EOF already supply the Python-facing communication interface precedent.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map interpreter boundary payloads to framed bytes and endpoint lifecycle to close/EOF, retaining the original distinction from process creation. The same-process endpoint adapter remains unverified rather than silently assumed.
